intro: Mongolia is a democratic parliamentary republic between two powerful neighbours.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The State Great Khural, the parliament, chooses the prime minister. The president is directly elected for a single six-year term.

chapters.title: Third neighbours
text: Mongolia seeks friends beyond Russia and China, such as Japan, South Korea and the US, a policy called 'third neighbours'.
